title: A good film about addiction and recovery to show at a rehab/residential treatment facility?

commenti.body:
This is basic but “Trainspotting”!

It’s not exactly “feel good” but it’s dynamic and covers a lot of ground on what you’re looking for I think.

I’d also point to other  films like “Melancholia”, “Rachel Getting Married”, “Uncut Gems”, “Doctor Sleep”, “Shame”, “The Fighter”, “Little Miss Sunshine” that have characters who have that facing addiction and/or recovery aspect of it.  Warning though, they’re not all feel good films! Lol
